# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| event-definition-canvas | `assets/event-definition-canvas.md`, one per use case | `funnel-use-case`, `funnel-requirements` | Request restated as object(s), event(s) and time axis; Every event marked source event or derived event with the method named; Every signal classified as sensor value, event or object identifier |
| object-relation | Section of the canvas | `mi-data-availability` | Identifier source for serial, order, part, batch or recipe is named, or the relation is routed as a data gap, never approximated from timestamps |
| archetype-class-category-method-etl-list | Section of the canvas | `catalog-standardization`, `ops-analytics-asset`, `mi-flow` | Class is cross-process, per-process or unique; Category to method to ETL mapping drafted; New ETL work stated |
| data-requirements-statement | `assets/data-requirements-statement.md`, filled | `mi-signals`, Data platform, information-integration lane | Written and handed on; Open questions for the plant listed |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| event-definition-canvas | structure of `assets/event-definition-canvas.md` | OD lead |
| object-relation | manual | OD lead |
| archetype-class-category-method-etl-list | manual | OD lead |
| data-requirements-statement | structure of `assets/data-requirements-statement.md` | Data platform |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `dept-intake`, `funnel-use-case`, `mi-data-availability`, `mi-equipment`
- **Next:** funnel-use-case, funnel-requirements and mi-signals; mi-data-availability for a missing relation; catalog-standardization and ops-analytics-asset for archetype and method.: `funnel-use-case`, `funnel-requirements`, `mi-signals`, `mi-data-availability`, `catalog-standardization`, `ops-analytics-asset`
- **Stops here when:** purpose, objective, timeframe or a named stakeholder is missing (back to dept-intake), the case is unique (impact analysis first, the OD lead or DBVE decides), or a derived event has no named method
- **Stops here when:** Do not promise a trace or per-order analysis without the object relation
